# Graham Corporation Completes CMMC Assessments at Two Business Units, Enhancing Defense Market Readiness and Cybersecurity for its Business Systems


November 10, 2026 8:00am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_28959b6d05aed8f009b533bd30f7116c/grahamcorp/news/2026-11-10_Graham_Corporation_Completes_CMMC_Assessments_at_413.pdf)


BATAVIA, N.Y.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Graham Corporation (NYSE: GHM) (“GHM” or the “Company”), a global leader in the design and manufacture of mission critical fluid, power, heat transfer, vacuum and advanced mixing technologies for the Defense, Space and Energy & Process industries, today announced that both its Graham Manufacturing and Barber-Nichols business units have successfully completed Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) assessments, reinforcing the company's commitment to cybersecurity excellence and the protection of sensitive customer and defense-related information.


The successful assessments reinforce Graham's commitment to safeguarding sensitive information while enhancing the Company's ability to compete for and execute work supporting national security, defense, aerospace and other mission-critical applications.


The assessments validate that both business units have implemented cybersecurity practices aligned with Department of Defense requirements for protecting sensitive government information. As cybersecurity requirements become an increasingly important factor in contract awards and supplier qualification, maintaining compliance helps position Graham to pursue strategic opportunities across the defense and aerospace sectors.


“Cybersecurity is a strategic business imperative and a critical part of our commitment to operational excellence and national security,” said Keith Oufnac, Chief Information Officer of Graham Corporation. “Successfully completing these assessments at Graham Manufacturing and Barber-Nichols reflects the dedication, discipline and collaboration of our teams and demonstrates our ability to implement and maintain cybersecurity controls across diverse operations. This achievement further strengthens our position as a trusted supplier for mission-critical programs, supporting the evolving needs of our defense, aerospace, energy and government customers.”


The assessments are part of Graham Corporation's broader strategy to strengthen operational excellence, reduce enterprise risk and support sustainable growth across its product portfolio. The Company remains committed to continuous improvement in cybersecurity, compliance and technology capabilities that enable long-term value creation for customers and shareholders.


**About Graham Corporation**


Graham is a global leader in the design and manufacture of mission critical fluid, power, heat transfer, vacuum and advanced mixing technologies for the Defense, Space, Energy & Process industries. Graham Corporation and its family of global brands are built upon world-renowned engineering expertise, proprietary technologies, as well as its responsive and flexible service and the unsurpassed quality customers have come to expect from the Company’s products and systems.
